# vgi-treasury

Query federal debt, operating cash, deposits, withdrawals and public debt transactions, and discover Fiscal Data endpoint fields. Treasury Fiscal Data is public and needs no upstream API key. Dates and currency amounts are typed, including exact decimals. Use date arguments and filters_json to reduce upstream work. page_size controls request size and max_rows=0 retrieves all matches. NULL arguments are rejected. Missing optional response fields return NULL. Upstream errors fail the query; SQL WHERE filters are local.

Queries use bounded HTTP responses and retries. Credentials stay out of continuation state. See README.md for deployment and operational limits.
